backtest_protocol.execution_model: Shared helper builds accepted source rows including the 52-week-high proximity core-flow helper, selects one paper trade per signal date by fixed source priority, applies a 12-trading-day same-ticker cooldown, then overlays next-open/10-day paper trade outcomes.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared accepted-helper source-priority allocator overlay

execution_envelope.notes: Top-1/day accepted-helper allocator, fixed $4,000 paper notional, 8 max active default-off paper positions, 10-trading-day hold, and 12-trading-day same-ticker cooldown. Source helpers keep their own liquidity guards; the 52-week source requires at least $75M 20-day average dollar volume. This experiment is not live-ready because the allocator still needs a dedicated realized-ledger kill switch before any trade_enabled=true release.

full_stack.materiality_note: Strict materiality is recorded for comparability. The binding candidate-pool materiality standard for this experiment is beating the accepted exp-20260610-005 allocator comparator after costs.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by changing 52-week source rank, allocator top-N, source thresholds, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source overlapped too much with higher-priority allocator rows or displaced better rows in at least one canonical window.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool/allocation alpha: add the already accepted 52-week-high proximity core-flow source to the accepted helper allocator at fixed rank 2, based on accepted standalone EV.

2_history_check.exp-20260610-005: Accepted source-priority allocator without 52-week source: aggregate EV +0.8971 and PnL +$14,502.52. This is the binding comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-006: Rejected macro-relief source extension: positive versus core but did not beat exp-20260610-005 and regressed old_thin versus comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-008: Accepted 52-week-high proximity core-flow shared helper: aggregate EV +0.4308 and PnL +$9,295.34 with all three windows positive.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Must improve aggregate EV/PnL, have no EV/PnL regression windows, satisfy sample/survival/drawdown/concentration guards, and beat exp-20260610-005 aggregate and per-window EV/PnL comparator.

prediction.confidence_reason: Money-making mechanism: accepted 52-week-high proximity core-flow rows capture anchoring underreaction at fresh long-term highs on days with same-day core A/B demand, while the allocator currently cannot see that source. Historical evidence: exp-20260610-008 accepted the shared 52-week helper with aggregate EV +0.4308 and PnL +$9,295.34 across all three windows, and exp-20260610-005 accepted the allocator without it. Main disconfirming risk: exp-20260610-006 showed accepted source-family additions can be redundant; 52-week rows may overlap higher-priority allocator winners or displace old_thin winners, causing comparator failure or drawdown drift.
